items.title: Capital.com plans UAE spot crypto services after affiliate wins licence
items.snippet: UAE clients will be able to buy and hold crypto through Capital.com’s app, expanding beyond price exposure through contracts for difference.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.snippet: "Bears in pain, right now," wrote bitcoin analyst James Check.

items.title: A $2 million bet on XRP volatility crosses the tape as prices surge
items.snippet: An options trader opened a large straddle on XRP, betting on wild price swings by Aug. 28.
